sources.snippet: OpenAI's Whisper is a state of the art auto-transcription model. Unfortunately for some, it requires a GPU to be effective. Whisper.cpp is an excellent port of Whisper in C++, which works quite well with a CPU, thereby eliminating the need for a GPU. Whisper.cpp is quite easy to compile on Linux & MacOS.
